page.overview:
Who is King Kai?

King Kai is a rather short individual with blue skin, pointed ears, and has a pair of catfish-like barbels on the sides of his face. He wears Teashade sunglasses, a pair of small white shoes, a black tunic with goldenrod-trimmed sleeves, as well as his symbol on the front, and has a pair of cricket-like antennae.

King Kai has a strong sense of humor, so much so that before he can agree to train someone, they have to make him laugh, and he tells very bad jokes. He is at least somewhat aware that his jokes are considered bad, as when trying to get Goku's attention while trying to telepathically warn him to finish off Frieza as the latter was powering up, he threatened that he'll start telling jokes, adding he has a lot of them if Goku doesn't respond to him soon, and even came close to carrying out the threat before Goku replied. He possesses great intelligence and knowledge about the universe and specializes in universal telepathic links. Even though he was already weaker than Vegeta before he taught Goku, King Kai is still a veritable library of skills, techniques and literally centuries of wisdom. He is very strategic and elaborate when it comes to planning, as evident during the Frieza Saga, organizing (alongside Kami) the transfer of all the Namekians and Z Fighters on Namek to Earth before the planet exploded. King Kai is a very eccentric mentor, as his methods training in martial arts appear to be very uncommon, such as making his student's first two tasks being: catch his pet monkey Bubbles and hitting his butler cricket sprite Gregory with a hammer (the latter task only happened in the anime as filler). Despite his odd training tactics, he appears to be an effective teacher and is proud of his students' growth. This is shown in his delight towards Goku accomplishing the aforementioned tasks, as well his concern towards Goku seeking to avenge Krillin by allowing Frieza to power up in full on the dying Planet Namek. These qualities display a strong bond between master and disciple, though King Kai did become irritated with Goku after he accidentally got him killed by teleporting the exploding Cell to his planet, and much later teased the upset Goku by suggesting that Delayed Onset Ki Disorder could prevent him from getting stronger.

King Kai can also be very immature, just like the rest of Kais, as he is seen constantly gloating to the other Kais about the strength of his fighters in his quadrant and bickering with them and insulting them as if they were brothers and sisters. He does appear to get along with them in some regard, though, congregating with them to watch the events of Dragon Ball Z: Fusion Reborn unfold (though possibly only because of their shared subordination under the Grand Kai).
